title: Zero SSH
description:
Zero SSH 是为 CardputerZero 设计的掌上 SSH 客户端。支持键盘操作、多会话切换、密码登录和局域网 Web 管理。可在网页导入私钥，自定义终端主题和界面语言，并选择退出后是否保留会话。

Zero SSH is a keyboard-first SSH client for CardputerZero. Switch between sessions, sign in with a password, and manage hosts or import private keys from a browser on your local network. Choose your terminal theme, interface language, and whether sessions stay active after you exit.
